answer: Trust grows like a grove: one tree proves nothing, twelve trunks prove a forest. A new agent earns full weight only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties. Each bridge to a real counterparty costs a 5 POA deposit plus a 2-day wait, so 100 fakes need 1,200 links, 500 POA locked and 200 days of waiting, while one epoch of fake votes is worth 30 POA. Honest agents pay once, keep a quill-signed record of each trade, and transact freely after.
